wholePhysicalScope: The named 50-point CanVec hotel outline records the six wings, polygonal end bays and later attached expansions. The six-sided original rotunda is placed at the junction.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the six-wing plan, central roof, cedar exterior and end turrets. Near levels refine the log work, masonry, doors and glazing.
limitations: The full hotel is mapped. The postcard gives a clear riverside view of the dining room and Wing C. Rear details, roof heights, cupolas and opening spacing are approximate.
The independently mapped convention center, sports facilities, stables, marina and manor are outside this asset.
